achievements: Architected a GitOps delivery model evolving from Terraform-only toward Argo CD–driven deployments, including PriorityClasses, drift awareness, and audit-friendly change paths across DeFi and Web3 workloads
Implemented production EKS autoscaling with Karpenter: EC2NodeClass and node lifecycle policies, with a 70% image garbage collection threshold to optimize cost while meeting SLA expectations

Built the observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager; Uptime Kuma for incident-style monitoring with Slack notifications and Argo CD deployment status integration

Migrated cluster-wide concerns where appropriate from Terraform to GitOps (e.g. PriorityClasses) for visibility in Argo CD; enabled GitHub Actions Terraform against the cluster via EKS access entries and IAM; standardized EKS add-ons to avoid duplicate components (e.g. metrics-server)

Hardened the cluster against a software supply-chain attack: built and deployed a Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall as a reusable Terraform module that blocks known malicious command-and-control domains at the VPC resolver (NXDOMAIN responses, a data-driven IOC blocklist, and CloudWatch query logging for incident investigation), so a compromised dependency cannot reach attacker infrastructure; and ran security audits across the cluster and cloud infrastructure to assess exposure and harden the environment

projects.title: AWS SES Inbound Email Router — Serverless Data Pipeline
projects.description: A config-driven AWS Lambda and Terraform module that ingests inbound email via Amazon SES, archives every message, routes attachments to per-client S3 destinations, and delivers HMAC-signed webhooks.
projects.longDescription: Production serverless pipeline for inbound-email ingestion. Amazon SES receives mail on a verified domain; an S3 ObjectCreated event triggers a Python 3.12 Lambda that archives the raw message for compliance, matches it against a JSON routing table in S3 (new clients and streams are added by editing config — no code change), validates the attachment, extracts the CSV, and writes it to the data lake. It then POSTs an HMAC-SHA256-signed webhook to the per-client backend and sends Slack notifications; unmatched or invalid mail is quarantined. Delivered as full Terraform IaC — SES domain/DKIM/receipt rules, three S3 buckets with lifecycle policies and KMS encryption, least-privilege IAM, Secrets Manager, an SQS dead-letter queue, and CloudWatch metric-filter alarms — with structured JSON logging, unit-tested pure functions, and a local fixture harness.

journals.title: Cost Optimization in Cloud Infrastructure: Factors Influencing the Nigerian Market and Organizational Strategies for Effective Management
journals.excerpt: This paper, titled "Cost Optimization in Cloud Infrastructure: Factors Influencing the Nigerian Market and Organizational Strategies," presents an in-depth academic analysis of the economic, infrastructural, regulatory, and cultural dimensions shaping cloud computing costs in Nigeria. It explores how foreign exchange volatility, energy instability, compliance requirements, and workforce readiness affect cloud adoption and financial performance. The study proposes strategic frameworks—such as FinOps practices, hybrid architectures, and local data center utilization—to enhance cost efficiency and sustainability in Nigeria's digital transformation journey. The work concludes with policy recommendations, future research directions, and reflections on how emerging economies can leverage cloud technologies for innovation and inclusive growth.
